thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: GPU pool us-west1-prod-1 reports sustained >90% GPU utilization + queue growth for model v28. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/reddo/gpu-autoscale

incidents-bot: Pager -> @Mike Ops (oncall) @Tara SRE

Mike Ops: acked. jumping in. seeing queue length climb on the inference queue, throttle spikes, autoscaler failing with 'scale_limit_reached' errors.

Jamie Eng: logs showing repeated KV cache misses + timeouts since v28 rollout. snippets: ```ERROR kv_fetch_timeout key=conv-usr-42 latency=1200ms``` also lots of `prefill_worker` spikes.

Deepa ML: confirmed we deployed v28 ~02:14 UTC. Config change was to expand prefix context handling (max_context_entries: 4096 -> 16384) and enable aggressive kv-prefetch. Might be exposing an internal hot-key pattern.

Mike Ops: metrics snapshot: ```gpu_pool_util=98%, queue_len=11.8k, throttle_rate=31%, kv_fetch_errors=14k/hr``` Autoscaler logs: `failed to scale: quota_exceeded` and `scaling_backoff=exponential`.

Tara SRE: taking lead for mitigation. quick decisions: mitigate customer impact first, then fix autoscale path. Steps I propose: 1) route 40% traffic to v27 stable 2) temporarily disable kv-prefetch on v28 3) request emergency capacity bump (quota) 4) if unstable, rollback v28.

Mike Ops: I started traffic split command (gradual):
```
# route 40% to v27
redwood route update --from model:v28 --to model:v27 --percent 40 --mode gradual
```

deploy-bot: route change enqueued, will complete in ~90s.

Support Lead: flagged 9 customers with elevated P95 latency (>10s). Two customers on SLA watch, no erroring 5xx at account level but many user-facing slow responses. Posting to status page: staging.

Deepa ML: toggling kv-prefetch off for v28 to reduce background KV pressure: ```cfg patch model.v28.kv_prefetch=false --env prod``` request in progress.

Jamie Eng: I can see immediate drop in KV fetch queue after the flag toggle starting at +45s. KV fetch errors down 60%. But GPU utilization still high due to cached contexts being larger and batch sizes spiking.

Mike Ops: tried scale up but cloud quota prevented adding more GPUs. I filed emergency quota request to infra and support ticket with provider (ticket #INC-9443). ETA unknown.

Tara SRE: next action: reduce v28 concurrency limit to shed load and force smaller batches. Command:
```
redwood config set model.v28.max_concurrency=6 --env prod
```
Applying now.

Jamie Eng: concurrency cap applied. we're seeing smaller batch sizes and lower token throughput per-worker. Queue is dropping from 11.8k -> 4.1k over 6 minutes. GPU util down to ~78%. Throttle_rate to 12%.

Support Lead: updated status: "Degraded performance for some customers; mitigation in progress. No full outage. Support routing to priority channels."

Deepa ML: however sample evals show regression in response quality when prefetch was disabled for v28 (some hallucination on long-context tasks). If we keep v28 in production we need to re-enable selective prefetch later or route latency-sensitive customers to v27.

Tara SRE: decision log: keep v28 live but limited. Traffic split: 40% -> v27, 60% -> v28 with kv_prefetch=false and concurrency cap. We'll continue monitoring and escalate to infra for quota bump; if queue >6k again or GPU util >90% for >10m, trigger rollback to v27 entirely.

Mike Ops: opening incident channel (pager thread) for postmortem capture. tagging owners: Deepa (model), Jamie (runtime), Tara (oncall), Mike (ops).

deploy-bot: route change complete. config changes applied.

incidents-bot: NOTE: handoff scheduled in 2 hours — Tara SRE will remain primary. If you are paged, refer to runbook stanza 4.

Support Lead: customers with severe impact: acct-892 (high latency), acct-777 (timeouts under load). Eng to prepare customer brief: cause = v28 context expansion + aggressive kv-prefetch => KV storm + autoscaler limits -> throttling. ETA for customer update in 45m.

Jamie Eng: collecting structured logs for the postmortem. capturing `kv_index_size` and `batch_size_hist` for 24h around deploy.

Mike Ops: current numbers at last check: queue_len=2.9k, gpu_util=72%, throttle_rate=8%. Will monitor 1h, then consider safe re-enable of selective prefetch on a small subset.

Tara SRE: thanks everyone. Action items added to incident board: (1) Postmortem (Deepa/Jamie) (2) Quota escalation follow-up (Mike) (3) Customer comms draft (Support Lead) (4) Autoscaler backoff fix ticket (Jamie). I'll update channel in 15m and close if stable 1h. :white_check_mark:

Support Lead: prepping customer note draft now.

Mike Ops: acknowledged, standing by.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied. Monitor window started.

Tara SRE: moving to monitoring phase. leaving brief notes in incident board. If anything spikes, ping me directly.

Support Lead: will post initial customer email in 40m for approval.

Jamie Eng: creating internal PR for autoscaler retry tuning (link: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pulls/332).

Deepa ML: working on safer prefetch strategy to avoid hotkeys and limit context prefetch per-session. Planning canary with 5% traffic when safe.

Mike Ops: closing thread for now — will re-open if thresholds breach.
